    Performative prediction
    Figure 1 Placeholder. An ML formalization of hyperstition, probably implicit in recommender dynamics, adversarial classification and some types of external validity, among other places. HT TJ for the pointer. In classical supervised learning we fit parameters to minimize expected loss over a distribution that sits passively and lets itself be measured, , with a feature–outcome pair and the loss. Specifically, while we assume the model watches the world, we assume that the world does not watch back. Performative prediction (Perdomo et al. 2020) is a formalization of a different regime wherein deploying the model changes the subsequent data distribution.
